Shift dates consistently within subject

Source: R/pseudonymization.R
dateShift.Rd

Derives one deterministic integer-day offset per subject using keyed HMAC-SHA-256. Exact elapsed intervals are preserved. Full shifted dates are pseudonymized personal data, not a HIPAA Safe Harbor output.

Usage

dateShift(
  dates,
  subject_id,
  key,
  range_days = c(-3650L, 3650L),
  inverse = FALSE
)

Arguments

dates

A Date or POSIXct vector.

subject_id

One subject ID or a vector aligned to dates.

key

Raw vector of at least 32 cryptographically random bytes.

range_days

Inclusive integer offset range.

inverse

Apply the exact negative keyed offset.

Value

A vector with the same length and date class.
